content.text:
`slugify` is implemented in `src/strings.js`, and `npm test` passes all 12 tests (the 2 existing ones plus 10 new).

It lowercases, strips diacritics (with `đ`/`Đ` mapped to `d`), turns each run of characters outside a-z and 0-9 into one hyphen, and trims leading and trailing hyphens. It cuts to 50 characters and then strips any trailing hyphen, so a slug cut at 50 never ends with one.

The new tests in `test/strings.test.js` cover:
- Basic hyphenation and diacritics, including Vietnamese text and `đ`/`Đ`.
- Runs of symbols, trimming, digits, and empty or symbol-only input.
- 50-character truncation, with and without a hyphen at the cut point.

The last test only checks that the result is at most 50 characters and doesn't end with a hyphen, so it is looser than the others.
